solutions.title: Linear range AND
solutions.strategy: Accumulate the AND from left to right, stopping early if the result becomes zero.

timeComplexity.explanation: In the worst case every value in the inclusive range is visited.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the accumulator and loop counter are stored.

solutions.title: Common prefix
solutions.strategy: Shift both ends right until they match, then restore the shared prefix.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each shift removes one binary digit from both endpoints.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the endpoints and shift count are tracked.
